name: armorer
desc: An outfitter in his fifties who sells oilskin and quilted weather-gear in a cold gorge town: solid and broad-faced, ruddy weathered skin, short steel-blue-grey hair and a neat clipped beard, kind shrewd eyes with deep crow's feet. He wears a slate-blue quilted coat with rolled seams and horn toggles over an oilskin under-layer, a measuring tape looped round his neck, a pincushion strapped to one wrist, and holds up a folded oilskin cape on one arm. The manner of a man who has kept a whole town dry.
sheetHint: solid and broad-faced, short steel-blue-grey hair and clipped beard, slate-blue quilted coat with horn toggles, oilskin under-layer, tape measure round neck, wrist pincushion, folded oilskin cape over arm
